topic_thesis: Health insurers collect 100% of your premium from day one while hiding 24 to 48-month Pre-Existing Disease (PED) clauses that legally allow them to reject 100% of your medical claims during your most vulnerable years.
strategic_angle: Expose the systemic trap where agents pitch 'instant full coverage' to collect high upfront commissions, while fine-print waiting period clauses convert your first 2-4 years of premiums into guaranteed profit for the insurer with zero claim risk.
key_statistic: 48-month waiting period / ₹1,00,000 premiums paid for ₹0 claim eligibility
target_emotion: Shock and immediate urge to audit existing health insurance policies
pinned_comment_text: Did your insurance agent sell you a policy without disclosing the 2-4 year PED waiting period? Comment 'CHECK' to get our free 3-step Policy Audit Checklist directly in your DMs! 💬👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Focus on middle-class Tamil Nadu families purchasing health plans through bank managers or agents ('Agent Sonna Nambaadheenga'). Highlight Tanglish terms like 'PED Waiting Period Trap', 'Claim Reject Aagama Look-in Period', and show how diabetes or BP declared late leads to absolute claim rejection despite paying 3 years of regular premiums.
